function.name: kyv_verify
function.description: Fetch signed, banded, machine-verifiable operational facts about a company domain (the kyv-attest convention: /.well-known/attestations.json), plus mechanical observed facts (HTTPS reachability, first CT certificate, RDAP registration date, first Wayback capture). Returns facts only — no rankings, no scores, no recommendations. Values are bands (e.g. ">=85"), never raw numbers. Absence of an attestation NEVER means negative: absence is non-adoption, not a signal.

domain.description: Public domain to verify, e.g. example.com
